description.value:
From D4C · Price: you must be pressed between two objects, such as a door and its frame, or under a flag.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action while sandwiched: step into a parallel world and reappear next to a different pair of objects within 30 ft.
  • 5: You can bring one willing adjacent creature.
  • 9: Surge: pull a creature caught between two objects into a parallel world for 1 round (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates). It returns at the start of your next turn.
  • 13: Range becomes 120 ft.
  • 17: Surge, once per day: bring a parallel copy of a creature into this world; if it touches its original, both take @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage (no save).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
